objective: Distinguish pre-notify guest delay from shim signal-to-resume delay on the same natural UPDATE page wait. Not a fix/adoption/performance test.
hooks: child binding from existing Fork context at instance creation
AtomicNotify attempt/return and exact channel close before/after in ThreadPool.wake
notifier callstack captured after close only when same registered wait exceeds100ms
semantic_limits: Not all earlier lock acquisitions/owners are instrumented. A matching notifier thread/call path is not necessarily the original owner. Query wait durations/notify bounds are measured; queue cause only if independently observed. Event hooks add scheduling overhead. No old-guest Fn name reuse.
gate: Correct SQL/isolation/cleanup, exact child/instance+wait-ID+channel/EA+notify binding and untruncated trace. Signal-before/after bounds bracket actual close; quantify resume relative to both, not a single ambiguous timestamp. Artificial tests/control never natural-cause proof. If no event, stop NOT_REPRODUCED. Root cause not inferred just from late notification.
